purpose: Maintenance benchmark for paper discovery. Do not publish these questions as new website pages or pass the target metadata to independent search agents.
protocol: Use only question text in a fresh search-enabled session; do not supply the target slug, author, paper title, website, baseline answer, or other conversation context.
Select papers on relevance. A citation through a journal or repository counts as a paper-discovery success; count citations to the library separately.
Record date/time, product or model, locale when known, exact search queries, paper selection, citation URL, version, and factual accuracy.
Tool response order is not a consumer search-engine rank. Reading order is not a universal quality ranking.
This is a purposive question set. Do not infer success across all topics or all AI services from it.
Preserve negative observations, access limits, and untested cases. Do not fabricate data or use paid APIs without authorization.
Repeat after observed crawl/index changes rather than continually issuing the same searches. No recurring task is configured by this file.

broad_question_runs.design: Three fresh agent contexts, with multiple questions researched in each. Target author, titles, site, and local project context were not supplied.
qualifications: Questions within each agent context were not independent sessions.
A4 used one exploratory query with Yang learned in another case. The target was not recommended.
C1 used one refinement with Guanyi learned in another case. That query is excluded as discovery evidence; an earlier neutral query found the target.
